paper_title: Understanding the impact of side-chains on photovoltaic performance in efficient all-polymer solar cells

knowledge_points.content: The donor polymers PT8, PTF8, PTS8, and PTFS8 are synthesized via Stille cross-coupling between the bis(trimethylstannane) of benzo[1,2-b:4,5-b']dithiophene (BDT) and the dibromides of thieno[3,4-c]pyrrole-4,6-dione (TPD).
knowledge_points.evidence: These polymers were synthesized using a Stille crosscoupling reaction between bis(trimethyl stannane) of BDT and the dibromides of TPD.

knowledge_points.content: The all-polymer solar cell based on the PT8:P(NDI2HD-T) blend achieves a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 8.00% with an open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 1.05 V, a short-circuit current (JSC) of 11.10 mA cm⁻², and a fill factor (FF) of 68.5%.
knowledge_points.evidence: With optimal HOMO levels and polymer crystallinity, a best PCE of 8.0% together with a high Voc of 1.05 V was obtained in PT8-P(NDI2HD-T) wide bandgap all-polymer cells.

knowledge_points.content: Side-chain fluorination in PTF8 and PTFS8 results in deeper HOMO energy levels (-5.60 eV and -5.73 eV, respectively) compared to the non-fluorinated PT8 (-5.33 eV) and PTS8 (-5.36 eV).
knowledge_points.evidence: The HOMO levels of PT8, PTF8, PTS8, and PTFS8 were measured as −5.33 eV, −5.60 eV, −5.36 eV, and −5.73 eV, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Alkylthio side-chains attached to the thiophene moiety slightly distort the polymer backbone planarity and red-shift the absorption spectra in solution.
knowledge_points.evidence: The alkylthio side-chains are appended to the thiophene moiety, which twists the polymer’s backbone... both the polymers PTS8 and PTFS8 show a distinct shoulder peak next to the absorption maximum in their solution spectra.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis reveals that the Crystal Correlation Length (CCL) of the (010) peak in the out-of-plane direction follows the order: PTF8 > PTFS8 > PT8 > PTS8, indicating that fluorinated polymers exhibit a more ordered structure.
knowledge_points.evidence: As shown in Fig. 4, the CCL of the (010) peak in the out-of-plane direction exhibits the following order: PTF8 > PTFS8 > PT8 > PTS8.

knowledge_points.content: Fluorination leads to a significant increase in the open-circuit voltage (VOC), with the PTF8-based device reaching a VOC of 1.22 V compared to 1.05 V for the PT8-based device.
knowledge_points.evidence: As a result of the lower HOMO level, PTF8 exhibits an improved open circuit voltage (Voc) compared to the template polymer PT8... these material developments assist in reaching an increased Voc of up to 1.22 V.

knowledge_points.content: The hole mobility of the fluorinated polymer PTF8 (3.1 × 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹) is approximately one order of magnitude higher than that of the non-fluorinated PT8 (3.2 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹).
knowledge_points.evidence: the hole mobilities of PT8, PTF8, PTS8, and PTFS8 are 3.2 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, 3.1 × 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, 2.4 × 10⁻⁵ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, and 4.8 × 10⁻⁵ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The extremely low HOMO level of PTFS8 (-5.73 eV) results in a marginal HOMO-HOMO offset with the acceptor P(NDI2HD-T), leading to poor charge transfer and a low PCE of 0.63%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The relatively low PCE of PTFS8-based devices can be attributed to the extremely low HOMO levels. These low energy levels result in a marginal HOMO–HOMO offset between the donor and acceptor polymers... PTFS8:P(NDI2HD-T) blend exhibits improved photoluminescence, indicating a much less efficient charge transfer.

knowledge_points.content: The optimal all-polymer solar cell fabrication involves using chloroform as the solvent, a donor/acceptor weight ratio of 1.3:1, 1% 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) as a solvent additive, and thermal annealing at 120 °C for 15 minutes.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optimal polymer/polymer weight ratio was determined to be 1.3:1... After the addition of 1% DIO and annealing the compound at 120 °C for 15 min, improved PCEs of 8.00%... were obtained.

knowledge_points.content: TEM imaging shows that the PT8:P(NDI2HD-T) blend forms a short nanofiber structure with moderate phase separation, whereas PTF8 and PTS8 blends exhibit excessive demixing and large domains over 20 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: For the PT8:P(NDI2HD-T) blend, the donor polymer exhibits a short nanofiber structure, and a moderate D–A phase separation... the size of both donor polymer-rich domains [in PTF8] is estimated to be over 20 nm.

knowledge_points.content: Fluorination and alkylthio substitution decrease the π-π stacking distance, with PTFS8 showing the smallest distance of 3.65 Å compared to 3.74 Å for PT8.
knowledge_points.evidence: the ‘‘π-π stacking’’ distance... is 3.74 Å, 3.68 Å, 3.69 Å, and 3.65 Å, for PT8, PTF8, PTS8, and PTFS8, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Non-covalent interactions and hydrogen bonding (F-H) between adjacent C-H and C-F units in fluorinated polymers are cited as factors that promote improved polymer organization and backbone planarity.
knowledge_points.evidence: Moreover, the formation of hydrogen bonding (F-H) for adjacent C–H and C–F units in the fluorinated conjugated materials can promote better polymer organization.
